disclaimer: All pricing rates in this dataset are illustrative benchmark figures designed for architecture cost modeling, capacity planning, and DevOps hackathon evaluation. Rates reflect typical US-East/Multi-region baseline public cloud pricing without reserved discounts, enterprise agreements, regional premiums, or dynamic egress surcharges.

resources.name: AWS t4g.micro (ARM Graviton2)
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, burstable ARM compute. Ideal for lightweight microservices, dev utilities, or low-traffic background workers.

resources.name: AWS t4g.small (ARM Graviton2)
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, burstable ARM compute. Great balance of cost and capacity for standard web backends and staging apps.

resources.name: AWS t4g.medium (ARM Graviton2)
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, burstable ARM compute. Recommended entry tier for production web APIs and container runtimes.

resources.name: AWS c6g.large (Compute Optimized)
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, dedicated compute optimized. Excellent for CPU-bound microservices, media transcoding, and batch tasks.

resources.name: AWS m6i.xlarge (General Purpose x86)
resources.description: 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Intel Xeon Scalable processor. Reliable general-purpose instance for multi-container deployments and enterprise workloads.

resources.name: AWS r6i.2xlarge (Memory Optimized)
resources.description: 8 vCPU, 64 GB RAM, memory-intensive instance for large caches, in-memory databases, and high-concurrency message queues.

resources.name: GCP e2-medium (Shared Core)
resources.description: 1 vCPU (burstable to 2), 4 GB RAM. Cost-efficient shared core compute for entry-level staging and staging environments.

resources.name: GCP n2-standard-4
resources.description: 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM balanced compute instance. Standard enterprise cloud tier for backend services and web applications.

resources.name: Custom Dedicated vCPU (Hourly)
resources.description: Standalone compute core capacity (1 vCPU equivalent, 3.0+ GHz). Use for fine-grained unbundled capacity modeling.

resources.name: Custom Dedicated RAM (GB/Hour)
resources.description: Standalone memory capacity (1 GB RAM per hour). Add alongside custom vCPUs without bundling discounts.

resources.name: AWS EBS General Purpose SSD (gp3)
resources.description: High-durability block storage with 3,000 baseline IOPS and 125 MB/s baseline throughput included. Standard for VM boot & data disks.

resources.name: AWS EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2)
resources.description: Mission-critical, low-latency block storage offering 99.999% durability. Designed for intensive transaction databases and enterprise SAP.

resources.name: GCP Persistent Disk Balanced SSD
resources.description: Alternative performance persistent disk balancing cost and read/write IOPS for cloud VM instances in Google Cloud.

resources.name: AWS S3 Standard Object Storage
resources.description: High-durability (99.999999999%) object storage for active user uploads, images, static websites, and analytical raw lakes.

resources.name: AWS S3 Infrequent Access (S3-IA)
resources.description: Lower-cost object tier for data accessed less frequently but requiring millisecond retrieval when requested.

resources.name: AWS S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
resources.description: Archive object storage with immediate access for quarterly backups, compliance data, and medical or regulatory records.

resources.name: AWS RDS PostgreSQL db.t4g.micro
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM managed relational database. Single-AZ configuration ideal for early dev/staging and low-traffic schemas.

resources.name: AWS RDS PostgreSQL db.t4g.medium
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM managed database with automated daily backups, minor version patches, and performance monitoring.

resources.name: AWS RDS PostgreSQL db.m6i.large (Multi-AZ)
resources.description: 2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM high-availability configuration with automatic synchronous standby replica across secondary availability zone.

resources.name: AWS Aurora Serverless v2 (ACU/Hour)
resources.description: 1 Aurora Capacity Unit (~2 GB RAM + scaling compute). Scales seamlessly in fractions of an ACU to match instant database load.

resources.name: Internet Data Egress (Bandwidth Out)
resources.description: Data transferred from cloud virtual machines or services out to the public internet beyond free monthly tiers (per GB).

resources.name: Managed NAT Gateway (Hourly Base)
resources.description: VPC Managed NAT Gateway instance running in a public subnet for secure outbound internet connectivity from private subnets.

resources.name: CDN Global Distribution Data Out
resources.description: Global edge caching content delivery network transfer out. Faster latency and lower origin egress costs.

resources.name: AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB)
resources.description: Layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy and load balancer. Supports path-based routing, TLS termination, and WebSockets.

resources.name: AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB)
resources.description: Ultra-high performance Layer 4 TCP/UDP load balancer handling millions of requests per second at ultra-low sub-millisecond latencies.

resources.name: AWS EKS Managed Control Plane
resources.description: Managed Kubernetes master node cluster control plane with multi-AZ etcd replication and automatic version updates.

resources.name: AWS Fargate Serverless Pod (per vCPU/Hr)
resources.description: Serverless container compute engine eliminating the need to provision, configure, or scale EC2 instances for Kubernetes pods.

resources.name: AWS Fargate Serverless Pod (per GB RAM/Hr)
resources.description: Memory allocation per hour for serverless Fargate tasks and Kubernetes pods.

resources.name: AWS Lambda Invocations (Per Million)
resources.description: Event-driven serverless compute invocation requests. (First 1,000,000 monthly requests often free in tier).

resources.name: AWS Lambda Compute Duration (100k GB-sec)
resources.description: Execution duration for ARM/x86 Lambda functions, priced per equivalent batch block of allocated GB-seconds.

resources.name: Custom CloudWatch Metrics (Per 10 Metrics)
resources.description: Custom application performance metrics for business KPIs, queue depths, and latency instrumentation ($3.00/metric/month).

resources.name: CloudWatch Logs Ingestion (per GB)
resources.description: Application and access log ingestion, compression, and real-time indexing into CloudWatch Logs or Datadog.
